question: When two functional traits in the same plant family are estimated on exactly the same species tips and phylogeny, are their estimated Blomberg K values still ordered differently?
scope: Exploratory within-AusTraits geometric and sample-support sensitivity only. Original K, homogeneous BM/OU and source-noise null verdicts are immutable.

source.named_trait_subset: 12 frozen source-calibrated traits; seed_height omitted based on K-blind source coverage gate originally frozen before its coverage result

eligibility.original_species_state_rule: Same frozen positive finite source-native unit record eligibility, record duplication and median per binomial with unique genus as original 254-system source pipeline.
eligibility.pre_intersection_support: Use only original K-eligible positive species in each of the 254 systems; all 254 original n_input_species counts must be independently reproduced, no new species admitted.
eligibility.shared_taxon_match: Within each family only, intersect two original K-eligible binomials and require identical genus labels across trait sources; never equate synonyms by fuzzy match, genus ambiguity is a HOLD.
eligibility.method: For every one of the 66 unique named-trait pairs, audit ALL original families where both traits occur; retain every family×pair with >=20 common species, without regard to original observed K or signed contrast.
eligibility.family_unit_of_independence: Family; multiple pairs within the same family are dependent.
eligibility.global_all_12_intersection: Not required. Pairwise shared-species K rankings must NOT be interpreted as a single transitive 12-trait rank hierarchy.

K_estimator.response: natural log of positive species-level median trait value; Blomberg's K via phytools::phylosig(method='K',test=FALSE) on identical tips and identical tree
tree_axes: V.PhyloMaker2 S3 built on pair-specific shared species
prune-only tree using original GBOTB.extended.TPL tips from exact same pair-specific shared species
K_estimator.contrast: delta_logK = log(K_trait_A_on_shared_tips) - log(K_trait_B_on_shared_tips), lexicographic trait A then trait B
K_estimator.additional_geometry_comparison: Compare paired same-tip logK differences to the original independently supported system logK differences, BUT their difference includes changed taxon support/geometry and cannot be assigned solely to a biological process.
K_estimator.tree_maker_source: Pinned native GBOTB ext tree and V.PhyloMaker2 at source commit, original family/taxon construction

outputs.step_1: K-blind support audit, every original family×trait graph and all 66 trait pairs, counts of shared positive species and n qualifying families; no species names or trait values leave runner.
outputs.step_2: For eligible family×pair: both trait K values on the same S3/prune tree, signed delta, original unmatched-tip difference and descriptive geometry shift; no species names in artifact.
outputs.summary: List of 66 pair support counts, all eligible family-level contrasts and per-pair sign agreement for pairs with >=5 independent families, along with S3/prune coverage; report descriptive signs but no selection/adaptation or inferential p-values.
outputs.no_hypothesis_upgrading: The five names were selected after seeing original K/source-OU outcomes; pair contrasts are NOT external validation.

hard_nonclaims: Matched tips remove the deterministic difference in tip support/tree geometry for a within-pair contrast; they do not equalize source quality, trait-specific measurement noise, phylogenetic covariance or effect size.
Zero matched-support is an identifiability limit, not evidence of equal evolutionary constraint.
A K ranking is not evolutionary rate and neither statistic by itself identifies alpha, sigma2 or adaptation.
BIEN original 201-system rho study is scientifically closed and will not be reopened.
TRY version 7 measurement-record independence has not been established.
